title: Koko Eating Bananas
keyIdea: Whether speed k finishes in h hours flips once from no to yes as k grows, so binary search the answer range 1 … max(piles). For a guess k, hours = Σ ceil(pile / k); fits → try slower (right = mid − 1), else faster.

approaches.name: Try every speed
approaches.idea: For k = 1, 2, …, compute the hours; return the first k that fits.
approaches.why: Up to max(piles) speeds (10⁹), each costing O(n): far too slow.

approaches.name: Binary search on the answer
approaches.idea: left = 1, right = max(piles). mid fits (hours ≤ h) → ans = mid, right = mid − 1; else left = mid + 1.
approaches.why: log₂(max) guesses, each summing n piles.

quiz.q: Why can you binary search when nothing is sorted?
options: "Fast enough?" is false then true as k grows; it flips exactly once

quiz.q: Hours for a pile of 7 at speed 3?
Why is hours a long long?
options: The total can exceed int when piles are huge and the speed is 1
